Care for It: To keep your jewellery looking its best, avoid contact with harsh chemicals like perfumes or cleaning products. Store it in its box when not in use to protect it from scratches.

For most non-personalised items, you have a whole year from the date of purchase to return them, as long as they’re in their original condition and packaging. Earrings can only be returned once per customer per year, and things like gift packaging, greeting cards, e-gift cards, and Advent Calendars aren’t returnable.
If you go for a custom or personalised piece, you can exchange it for store credit within 30 days of delivery (refunds aren’t available for personalised items). Only one exchange per original order is allowed.
If you need more details or want to start a return, just let me know! I’m here to help every step of the way.
